name: Hawaii Big Island 2020

venue.name: Kanu o ka ʻĀina Learning ʻOhana

information: We are back for the third ever competition in Hawaii! Join us at the Big Island for an exciting competition featuring 7 events! Please read the Registration Requirements for this competition in order to ensure prompt registration acceptance. In accordance with Regulation 2t, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations.
